description: Source code for HashicorpSecretManager class, which manages secrets in Hashicorp Vault, including authentication, secret retrieval, storage, and deletion, with support for AppRole and TLS cert authentication.

classes.name: HashicorpSecretManager
classes.description: Manages secrets in Hashicorp Vault with methods for authentication, reading, writing, rotating, and deleting secrets, supporting multiple authentication methods and caching.

methods.name: __init__
methods.description: Initializes the secret manager, sets up configuration from environment variables, and enforces premium user access.

methods.name: _verify_required_credentials_exist
methods.description: Checks that at least one authentication credential (token or AppRole) is configured.

methods.name: _auth_via_approle
methods.description: Authenticates to Vault using AppRole method, caches token with lease duration.

methods.name: _auth_via_tls_cert
methods.description: Authenticates to Vault using TLS certificate, caches token with lease duration.

methods.name: get_url
methods.description: Constructs the URL for accessing a secret in Vault, supporting namespace, mount, and path prefix.

methods.name: _sanitize_plain_value
methods.description: Sanitizes a value to a non-empty string or None.

methods.name: _sanitize_path_component
methods.description: Sanitizes a path component string, removing leading/trailing slashes.

methods.name: _extract_secret_manager_settings
methods.description: Extracts secret manager related settings from optional parameters.

methods.name: _build_secret_target
methods.description: Builds the secret target info including URL and data key based on parameters.

methods.name: _get_request_headers
methods.description: Determines the appropriate authentication headers based on available credentials.

methods.name: async_read_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously reads a secret from Vault, utilizing cache and HTTPX client.

methods.name: sync_read_secret
methods.description: Synchronously reads a secret from Vault, utilizing cache and HTTPX client.

methods.name: async_write_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously writes a secret to Vault with optional description and parameters.

methods.name: async_delete_secret
methods.description: Asynchronously deletes a secret from Vault and clears cache.

methods.name: _get_secret_value_from_json_response
methods.description: Extracts the secret value from Vault's JSON response, assuming key 'key'.
